channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Russian strikes kill eight, injure dozens across Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian leader Zelenskyy says Moscow launched nearly 4,000 drones, aerial bombs and missiles on Ukraine in past week.

item.title: 14 killed, a dozen missing as Nepal is hit by more floods and landslides
item.description: At least 14 people have been killed and 11 remain missing after heavy rain triggered floods and landslides across Nepal.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran open to ‘real diplomacy’, ready for ‘apocalyptic war’
item.description: Abbas Araghchi's warning comes after Washington rejected a seven-day roadmap to end the war and reopen Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Deadly strike hits market in Yemen’s Taiz
item.description: A strike on a market in the Yemeni city of Taiz has killed at least seven people and wounded 40.

item.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
item.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

item.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
item.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

item.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
item.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.
